claim: In the HWA laboratory, conman offers altpri, link, unlink, limit, release, resource as the runtime manipulation commands; there are no standalone shift or move commands. altpri requires the job in a targetable state; an attempt against a job not yet in selection returned AWSBHU072E no objects match.
source_url: local conman help commands and altpri attempt
notes: Priority change via altpri is state-dependent.
